name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: The official collection of plug-and-play add-ons that make the Cursor AI coding editor work better with specific tools, frameworks, and company workflows.
buyer: A SaaS company (like a CI tool or framework maker) that wants its product featured as an official Cursor plugin so more developers adopt it.
business_use_cases: A dev-tools startup writes and submits a plugin so Cursor users discover their product directly inside their editor.
An agency that specializes in Cursor onboarding builds and sells custom internal-workflow plugins to enterprise engineering teams.
A framework maintainer builds a plugin instead of writing more docs, cutting support tickets.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid 'get featured as an official Cursor plugin' consulting to SaaS companies that lack in-house expertise.
Build and sell premium internal-workflow plugins to engineering orgs standardizing on Cursor.

steal_this: Pick one popular SaaS tool without a Cursor plugin yet, write one this weekend, and submit it for free distribution to every Cursor user.
